name: Super Strength server script
notes: InitObjectPickup 0x100007A2 on Batman; PickupObject 0x100007A1 and ThrowObject 0x100007A0 on Batman and the object; hit effects on the target; _Combat_GoToLocomotion. S4 = RaiseEvent(TargetIID)[0x10000037] + input hold node 0x100000AD until 0x100000BB (S4 -> S3: StartCooldown); with no 0x100000BB the champion cannot move and the 90 s cooldown never starts (C, 2026-10-30 run 11:10-11:16, liftable-softlock.md 1). S0 -> S2 -> S4 needs EntityExists + IsTargetable(TargetIID): an order with target 0x0 keeps the VM's last TargetIID (P: the original cleared it).
